audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart reads "Skill" for Levels 1 through 4-5 while the content layer win[0..3] and the packet levelChart both read "Brand". Two different answers render for the same rows.
audit.why: Brand's Q-W poke with Blaze stacking beats Anivia's 1075-range Flash Frost pre-6; both other sources agree Brand owns the early rows.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side = Brand, matching win[0..3] and the packet chart. Anivia takes rows 4-6 as already recorded.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] (Lvl 6) describes Pillar of Flame, which is his level-1 W, not the level-6 spike.
audit.why: The level-6 spike is Pyroclasm (100/90/80s), which bounces up to 5 times off Brand and nearby enemies and prioritises stacking Blaze to max on champions. Naming Pillar there hides the actual spike.
audit.corrected: Spike text now names Pyroclasm and contrasts its bounce with Flash Frost's single 1075 line.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.mid claims "his ult chains off your own R". Pyroclasm bounces off Brand and enemy champions, not off Anivia's Glacial Storm. Several fields also treat Sear as an unconditional stun.
audit.why: Sear only stuns a target that is already ablaze, so the decisive dodge is Pillar of Flame (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) and Conflagration (13/12/11/10/9s) — stay clean of Blaze and his Q is damage only. Brand has no dash, so Crystallize is a true cage rather than a dash-block.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.mid, breakdown.cooldowns, enemyWin, breakdown.carry, ahead and the do/don't details around the Blaze-then-Sear ordering and Brand's lack of mobility.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged "Glacial Storm's" as a probable wrong ability name. It is correct — Riot's own Frostbite text references "a fully formed Glacial Storm". False positive; left alone.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Crystallize for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Sear stuns only while Blaze is on you, so the dodge that matters is Pillar of Flame and Conflagration — Conflagration is down 13s at rank 1, and clean of Blaze his Q is just damage. - Budget Crystallize for emergencies, R for opportunities.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Brand wins by landing Blaze first — then Sear stuns, Conflagration spreads double, and the combo kills bird and egg.

edits.before: Ahead, the lane is a prison: storm every wave, wall Brand away from the comeback farm, and rotate first to every river fight with your stun loaded.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the reset: Brand only regains mana killing ablaze targets, so storm his wave, wall him off the catch-up farm, and he runs dry.

edits.before: Carry by controlling space — storm and wall decide where fights happen, and your stun decides who dies first inside them.
edits.after: Carry by denying Blaze — an Anivia who is never ablaze cannot be stunned, and Brand without his stun is burn he cannot land twice.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Brand burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Brand has no dash — Crystallize behind him is a real cage. Drop it as he steps to Conflagration range (625) and he walks out the long way.

edits.before: Brand whiffs Sear (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Sear whiffed is 8 seconds of free lane — Q, Frostbite, walk.

edits.before: That is Brand’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Blaze at three stacks detonates by itself — ablaze at half HP is his window, not yours.

edits.before: Your wall is your Flash — a wasted Crystallize means the next gank kills the bird AND the egg.
edits.after: Flash Frost is an 11-second cooldown at rank 1 — spend it on his step-up, not on a sidestepped poke.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Brand walks straight at you.
edits.after: Brand out-ranges the fight at 1050 on Sear with Blaze already ticking — away from tower you cannot walk out of the burn.

edits.before: Brand keeps the damage lead through level 5, since Pillar of Flame punishes any minion-wave positioning mistake and his ult chains off your own R if you're both mid-fight. Once you hit 6 the fight becomes closer — Glacial Storm's sustained slow-zone damage rivals his burst — but he still edges the pure damage race until you get real itemization. Watch for his all-in the moment he lands a full Q-W-E combo; that's when he commits hardest.
edits.after: Brand keeps the damage lead through level 5: Pillar of Flame punishes any minion-wave mistake, and once Blaze is on you Sear stuns instead of merely chipping. Once you hit 6 the fight becomes closer — Glacial Storm's sustained slow-zone damage rivals his burst — but he edges the raw damage race until real itemization. His commit order is W into E into Q; dodge the Pillar and the Q cannot stun.

edits.before: Both get game-changing ultimates, but Brand's Pillar of Flame still lands easier through minion clutter than your Flash Frost.
edits.after: Both get ultimates, but Pyroclasm bounces off minions onto you while your Flash Frost still has to travel a clean 1075 line.
